full_prompt_en: A square lyrical mixed-media painting looks over an open pale coastal plain toward a horizontal band of blue water and low far hills. A broad cream path begins near the bottom center and recedes into the distance, where tiny dark walking figures appear in scattered groups. The ground is marked by hair-thin lines, pinlike posts, scratch marks, small circular stains, and fine drips. The sky takes up the upper half as a faded powder blue wash, not a smooth solid fill. Near the upper left hangs a rough orange sunburst with a dark center; at upper right a lightly drawn eye-like form contains a small ocher circle. Other tiny amber dots, spoked seed-head shapes, and floating symbols drift across sky and land, never forming readable writing. The central waterline is almost level, while a slight bend of shore at the left gives the landscape depth. The main visual event is the contrast between huge open pale space and many dispersed marks, some real-world figures and others imaginary diagrams. Paint is scraped, spattered, and washed thin; small details seem drawn over earlier layers. Colors are restrained to cream, powder blue, gray, ocher, rust, and dark ink. The composition has no single oversized focal form. Instead, the path, walkers, strange orange sun, and eye shape establish a wandering rhythm across the frame. The mood is light, curious, and poetic, as if ordinary seaside observation and a private visual map occupy the same page.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形抒情综合媒介绘画越过开阔浅色海滨平原，望向一条水平蓝水带与低远山。宽奶油色路径从下中部开始向远方退去，细小深色行人在那里零散成群。地面布满发丝细线、针般柱、刮痕、小圆污点和细滴痕。天空占上半幅，是褪色粉蓝水洗，不是平滑纯色。左上悬着一枚粗橙色放射日形，中心深暗；右上轻描一枚眼状形，内部有小赭色圆。其他极小琥珀点、辐条种头形和漂浮记号散在天地间，却不构成可读文字。中央水线几乎水平，左边微弯海岸给出纵深。主要视觉事件是巨大开放浅空间与众多分散记号的对比，其中既有现实人物，也有想象图示。颜料被刮、泼、稀洗；小细节像在早期层上再画。颜色限于奶油、粉蓝、灰、赭、锈和深墨。构图没有唯一放大焦点形，而由道路、行人、奇异橙日和眼形建立贯穿全幅的游走节律。气氛轻、好奇且诗意，仿佛日常海边观察与私人视觉地图落在同一页。
style_prompt_en: Use lyrical mixed-media painting with broad thin washes, scratched fine lines, tiny dispersed marks, and occasional rust-orange circular accents. Leave large pale fields of cream and powder blue, then organize them with a low horizon and one faint receding route. Let some marks be observational and others diagrammatic, without resolving them into readable symbols. Preserve spatters, drips, rubbed patches, and transparent earlier layers. Keep scale playful: very small dark anchors should make the open field feel immense. The result is airy, curious, and poetic, with visual rhythm arising from scattered microdetails rather than a dominant central object.
style_prompt_zh: 采用抒情综合媒介绘画，以宽薄水洗、刮出细线、分散小记号和偶尔锈橙圆重音构图。留大片奶油与粉蓝浅场，再以低地平线和一道淡淡后退路径组织。部分记号来自观察，另一些像图示，却不落实为可读符号。保留泼点、滴痕、擦抹块和透明早层。尺度有趣：极小深锚点让开阔场显得巨大。结果透气、好奇且诗意，视觉节律来自散布的微细节，而非主导中央物。
theme_en: A pale coastal plain dotted with tiny walkers and floating orange signs
theme_zh: 淡色海滨平原上散着微小行人与漂浮橙色记号
name: John Olsen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
